desc: This Frigidaire 30 in. Freestanding Electric Range offers a 5.3 cu. ft. capacity oven and a 4-element electric cooktop featuring two 8 in. and two 6 in. coil elements, so you can cook more at once. The cooktop includes indicator lights that let you know when it's still hot, while the large oven window allows you to easily monitor food as it bakes.
